meta.name: dev-external-context
meta.description: Parallel external documentation lookup. Spawn multiple @scroll-docs agents simultaneously to fetch SDK refs, API docs, and framework guides for different topics in one pass.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行查询多个外部文档，一次获取多份参考资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要同时查阅多个SDK或API文档
copy.tagline_en: Query multiple external docs in parallel, fetching references at once
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to consult multiple SDK or API docs simultaneously

howto.what: Claude 能并行查询多个外部文档（如 SDK、API、框架指南），并将结果汇总成一份包含综合分析和冲突点的研究摘要。
howto.when: 当你需要同时查阅多个不相关的外部资料（例如 SDK A、框架 B、标准 C）时触发。通常用于一次任务涉及 3 个以上不同话题的查询。
howto.what_en: Claude spawns multiple @scroll-docs agents in parallel to fetch SDK refs, API docs, and framework guides, then synthesizes a single research summary with cross-references and conflict notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task requires multiple unrelated external lookups, typically 3+ different topics such as SDK A, Framework B, and Standard C.

say_en.text: Look up Vue3 reactive API, React useEffect, and Svelte store usage.
say_en.note: Fetches docs for three frameworks in parallel.

say_en.text: Compare SDK differences among AWS S3, Azure Blob, and GCP Cloud Storage.
say_en.note: Retrieves each SDK doc and generates a comparison.
